detailMarkdown:
# Claude Code MCP Production Readiness Capability Pack Skill

Expert Claude Code skill capability pack for taking MCP integrations from local proof-of-concept to production-ready, permissioned, observable workflows.

## Trust
- Source: source-backed
- Package: maintainer-built/verified package
- Review: unclaimed

## Safety notes
- MCP servers can execute tools, read resources, and expose prompts; approve only trusted servers and review each tool boundary before use.
- Project-scoped .mcp.json changes affect collaborators after trust approval, so document server purpose, transport, and rollback steps.
- Remote MCP servers and OAuth flows can change account data depending on granted scopes; test with least-privilege credentials first.

## Privacy notes
- MCP resources may expose local files, database metadata, ticket content, or third-party service data to Claude Code during retrieval.
- OAuth tokens and API keys must stay out of committed .mcp.json files, logs, screenshots, and shared transcripts.
- Server logs may retain prompts, tool inputs, resource identifiers, and error payloads; define retention and redaction before rollout.

## Install
```bash
curl -L https://heyclau.de/downloads/skills/claude-code-mcp-production-readiness-capability-pack.zip -o claude-code-mcp-production-readiness-capability-pack.zip && unzip -o claude-code-mcp-production-readiness-capability-pack.zip -d ./claude-code-mcp-production-readiness-capability-pack
```

## Usage
Use this skill before shipping Claude Code MCP servers or shared .mcp.json configuration to a team, CI workflow, or production operator environment.
